Subject: EOQ: Final cadence — commit surge & reconciliation

Team — kicking off a tight end-of-quarter cadence to close out Q4 forecasts. I attached the EOQ_commit_tracker.xlsx (tabbed by owner). Please do the following by 3:00pm PT today so we can publish a lock at EOD: 1) update each ACV/opportunity row with final stage (Proposal / Contracting / Signed), 2) set "commit_confidence" to High/Medium/Low and add one line justification, 3) mark whether PO/Contract signed and drop any docs into the tracker or thread.

Quick rules for this rollup: any PO or signed contract = commit. "Contracting" + finance approval email = commit. If legal redlines remain, mark as "Pending Legal" and provide estimated resolution time. We need a clean list for finance to cut bookings and for the exec deck.

I'll consolidate and send a 6:00pm PT rollup. Call out any blockers you want me to surface up (credits, unusual terms, extended payment terms).

Neha
